newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet names new top finance civil servant.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet names new top finance civil servant.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday appointed Supachai Pisitvanich as the new top civil servant at the finance ministry, succeeding outspoken and popular Chatumongol Sonakul, who quit after his transfer to an inactive post.
Ministers attending a weekly cabinet meeting said Supachai, who had headed various departments in the ministry, was promoted to permanent secretary for finance from deputy permanent secretary.
The appointment coincided with the Thai government's approval of tough measures aimed at boosting the economy under an International Monetary Fund (IMF) rescue package.
